scenes.tts: If glia feed axons, the fuel must leave the glial cell. What happens if you block the exit?
scenes.visual: Title card: Cut the Export Line. A glial cell with a gate in its membrane; lactate waits behind it.
scenes.narration: If glia feed axons, the fuel must leave the glial cell. What happens if you block the exit?

scenes.tts: Lactate leaves on transporters. In twenty twelve, Jeffrey Rothstein's group showed that one, M C T one, is concentrated in oligodendrocytes.
scenes.caption: Lactate leaves on transporters. In 2012, Jeffrey Rothstein's group showed that one, MCT1, is concentrated in oligodendrocytes.
scenes.visual: A transporter labelled MCT1 carries lactate and pyruvate across a membrane. Then a reporter-mouse style image: MCT1 lights up oligodendrocytes. Credit: Lee, Rothstein and colleagues, 2012.
scenes.narration: Lactate leaves on transporters. In 2012, Jeffrey Rothstein's group showed that one, MCT1, is concentrated in oligodendrocytes.

scenes.tts: In spinal cord slices, they withheld glucose briefly. Some slices also got a drug that blocks M C T one. Some of those also got lactate.
scenes.caption: In spinal cord slices, they withheld glucose briefly. Some slices also got a drug that blocks MCT1. Some of those also got lactate.
scenes.visual: A spinal cord slice in a dish. Three conditions appear as empty bars: glucose withheld; plus MCT1 blocked; plus MCT1 blocked and lactate added.
scenes.narration: In spinal cord slices, they withheld glucose briefly. Some slices also got a drug that blocks MCT1. Some of those also got lactate.

scenes.tts: What happens to the motor neurons in each condition?
scenes.visual: Pause and predict card beside the three empty bars.
scenes.narration: What happens to the motor neurons in each condition?

scenes.tts: With glucose withheld, they survived. Add the blocker, and they died. Add lactate with the blocker still on, and they survived.
scenes.visual: The bars fill in turn: survive; die; survive. Label on bar 3: lactate added, MCT1 still blocked.
scenes.narration: With glucose withheld, they survived. Add the blocker, and they died. Add lactate with the blocker still on, and they survived.

scenes.tts: That is a rescue. The best reading is that the neurons lacked lactate, which glia are thought to supply. Other drug effects are not ruled out.
scenes.visual: The word rescue on screen. Two tags: block, is it necessary? Add back, is it enough? Small print: other drug effects not ruled out; the drug acts on every cell in the slice.
scenes.narration: That is a rescue. The best reading is that the neurons lacked lactate, which glia are thought to supply. Other drug effects are not ruled out.

scenes.tts: In living mice, lowering M C T one in the spinal cord made axons swell and degenerate. Motor neurons were lost.
scenes.caption: In living mice, lowering MCT1 in the spinal cord made axons swell and degenerate. Motor neurons were lost.
scenes.visual: A mouse spinal cord: axons swell and fragment, and motor neuron cell bodies fade.
scenes.narration: In living mice, lowering MCT1 in the spinal cord made axons swell and degenerate. Motor neurons were lost.

scenes.tts: A cleaner test came in twenty twenty one. Deleting M C T one only in oligodendrocyte lineage cells left young mice normal.
scenes.caption: A cleaner test came in 2021. Deleting MCT1 only in oligodendrocyte lineage cells left young mice normal.
scenes.visual: Credit: Philips and colleagues, 2021. An ageing timeline begins: young, axons normal.
scenes.narration: A cleaner test came in 2021. Deleting MCT1 only in oligodendrocyte lineage cells left young mice normal.

scenes.tts: As the mice aged, axons degenerated and myelin thinned.
scenes.visual: The timeline runs on: old, axons degenerating and myelin thinner.
scenes.narration: As the mice aged, axons degenerated and myelin thinned.

scenes.tts: Side by side: with glial respiration switched off, adult brain axons were spared over the months studied. Remove M C T one, the proposed export route, and axons degenerate with age.
scenes.visual: Split screen. Left, labelled adult CNS: Cox10 deleted, label respiration switched off, axon spared, green tick. Right, labelled ageing mice: MCT1 deleted, label monocarboxylate transport removed, axon degenerating, red cross.
scenes.narration: Side by side: with glial respiration switched off, adult brain axons were spared over the months studied. Remove MCT1, the proposed export route, and axons degenerate with age.
scenes.caption: Side by side: with glial respiration switched off, adult brain axons were spared over the months studied. Remove MCT1, the proposed export route, and axons degenerate with age.

scenes.tts: One caution: the two sets of mice were not followed over matched ages, and myelin also thinned late.
scenes.visual: A small caution card under the split screen: ages not matched; myelin also thinned late.
scenes.narration: One caution: the two sets of mice were not followed over matched ages, and myelin also thinned late.

scenes.tts: So the picture that fits is this. Oligodendrocytes run glycolysis and export lactate or pyruvate through M C T one. The axon turns any lactate back into pyruvate and burns it in its own mitochondria.
scenes.caption: So the picture that fits is this. Oligodendrocytes run glycolysis and export lactate or pyruvate through MCT1. The axon turns any lactate back into pyruvate and burns it in its own mitochondria.
scenes.visual: Label: the picture that fits. An oligodendrocyte takes in glucose, runs glycolysis, and sends lactate or pyruvate out through MCT1 along a dashed arrow. Inside the axon, lactate becomes pyruvate and enters an axonal mitochondrion.
scenes.narration: So the picture that fits is this. Oligodendrocytes run glycolysis and export lactate or pyruvate through MCT1. The axon turns any lactate back into pyruvate and burns it in its own mitochondria.

scenes.tts: Still unknown: the exact route, and how much of an axon's A T P this supplies. These experiments infer the transfer; none of them traces it.
scenes.caption: Still unknown: the exact route, and how much of an axon's ATP this supplies. These experiments infer the transfer; none of them traces it.
scenes.visual: A still-unknown card with two lines: the route; the fraction of the axon's ATP. A labelled molecule with a dotted, unfinished path from glia to axon.
scenes.narration: Still unknown: the exact route, and how much of an axon's ATP this supplies. These experiments infer the transfer; none of them traces it.

scenes.tts: Astrocytes are a second, contested candidate. One sensor study in mouse cortex reported a lactate gradient from astrocytes to neurons.
scenes.visual: Coda card: astrocytes. One study for: a lactate gradient from astrocyte to neuron; small print: a gradient, not a measured flow. Credit: Mächler, Weber and colleagues, 2016.
scenes.narration: Astrocytes are a second, contested candidate. One sensor study in mouse cortex reported a lactate gradient from astrocytes to neurons.

scenes.tts: Another saw stimulated neurons raise their own glycolysis, with no sign of lactate import.
scenes.visual: One study against: a stimulated neuron's own glycolysis rises; the lactate import arrow is absent. Credit: Yellen laboratory, 2017.
scenes.narration: Another saw stimulated neurons raise their own glycolysis, with no sign of lactate import.

scenes.tts: So the astrocyte shuttle remains a hypothesis with partial support.
scenes.visual: Card: astrocyte-neuron lactate shuttle, a hypothesis with partial support.
scenes.narration: So the astrocyte shuttle remains a hypothesis with partial support.

scenes.tts: For the axon under myelin, the evidence fits one picture. Whoever wraps the axon helps feed it.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: whoever wraps the axon helps feed it. Small line: oligodendrocytes most clearly.
scenes.narration: For the axon under myelin, the evidence fits one picture. Whoever wraps the axon helps feed it.
